reason: Expert provides a known false alarm rule and workaround for a battery alarm latching after a power outage.

knowledge.summary: After a power outage, battery alarms on this unit stay latched even after mains power returns; clear the alarm latch remotely and verify battery voltage exceeds 52 V instead of dispatching.
knowledge.author: Erkki Expert
knowledge.details: Verify battery voltage is above 52 V after clearing the alarm latch.
